description: Golden queries for agentic vs single-pass evaluation. Tags: 1x = one retrieval suffices, 2x = two pieces of evidence, nx = three or more, unanswerable = must refuse.

queries.query: Why were the nightly backup jobs failing with 'No space left on device'?
queries.expected_answer: Snapshot retention was still 90 days; retention was cut to 30 days and 4 TB of expired snapshots were purged.

queries.query: How was the credential stuffing attack on the customer login page stopped?
queries.expected_answer: Attacking IP ranges were blocked at the WAF, login rate limiting was enabled and 12 accounts had passwords reset.

queries.query: Why did the checkout API return HTTP 503 errors during the campaign traffic peak?
queries.expected_answer: The autoscaling group hit the regional vCPU quota; the quota was raised to 512 and the group maximum to 40.

queries.query: Remote users were disconnected from the VPN every 60 minutes. What fixed it?
queries.expected_answer: The IPsec phase 2 rekey lifetimes were aligned to 28800 seconds on both gateways and dead peer detection was enabled.

queries.query: Why was outbound email stuck in the SMTP relay queue?
queries.expected_answer: The relay's TLS certificate expired; it was renewed, Postfix reloaded and the queue flushed.

queries.query: What fixed slow API endpoint response times caused by missing database indexes?
queries.expected_answer: A composite index on user_id and timestamp, a larger connection pool and Redis query caching.

queries.query: Is INC980201 resolved, and what is the status of its follow-up to automate certificate renewal?
queries.expected_answer: INC980201 is resolved; the follow-up CHG980202 is in progress.

queries.query: What caused the DB01 replication lag incident, and what alerting was added as a follow-up?
queries.expected_answer: The analytics export saturated replica I/O; the follow-up added a Prometheus alert on replication lag over 60 seconds.

queries.query: What are the status and SLA of ACC980601 and of PRF980801?
queries.expected_answer: ACC980601 is New with a 720-minute SLA; PRF980801 is In Progress with a 240-minute SLA.

queries.query: Is SEC980701 resolved and what was its SLA?
queries.expected_answer: Yes, it is resolved; its SLA was 15 minutes.

queries.query: What caused the checkout 503 incident, and what is the status of the capacity review that followed it?
queries.expected_answer: An exhausted vCPU quota; the capacity review PRB980302 is pending finance approval.

queries.query: How were the VPN drops fixed for remote users, and for the laptop on a docking station?
queries.expected_answer: Aligned IPsec rekey lifetimes for remote users; dock firmware update and disabled adapter power saving for the laptop.

queries.query: Compare how the DB01 replication lag and the DB02 reporting query timeouts were handled. Which one is still open?
queries.expected_answer: DB01 lag was resolved by moving the analytics export; the DB02 timeouts (PRF980801) are still in progress pending an index rebuild.

queries.query: Disks filled up in the backup server, the Prometheus server and the order service. How was each one fixed?
queries.expected_answer: Backup retention cut to 30 days; Prometheus retention cut and volume extended; order service debug logging disabled and logrotate added.

queries.query: What follow-up work came out of INC980201 and INC980301, and what is the status of each follow-up?
queries.expected_answer: CHG980202 (certificate automation) is in progress; PRB980302 (capacity review) is pending.
